correctness.rationale: For the exact 12-vertex Franklin graph with cycle edges and even-index +5 chords, the independent-set face numbers are (12,48,76,45,12,2), independently enumerated. Inspected check_franklin.py builds 195 independent faces, an exhaustive 95-pair acyclic Morse matching with one critical vertex/four critical triangles, and signed B2/B3 ranks 37/35. Twenty induced three-edge matchings give octahedral 2-cycles. Four specified cycles plus B3 form rank39 primitive lattice by all unit Smith invariants, hence integral H2=Z4 and a genuine integral basis. All 48 group automorphisms act by signed integer matrices; check_franklin.py explicitly verifies 2304 products, generator closure and determinant-one action, primitive vector (1,1,1,1) fixed, character mean 1 and squared norm 2, central half-turn trace -2 and S4×C2 splitting. The quotient has rational cohomology Q in degrees 0 and 2 because the finite group invariant rational H2 line has dimension one; integral quotient cohomology not claimed. Independent networkx confirms the Franklin distance-three graph is isomorphic to Franklin itself and the known VR-at-scale-2 complex is an isomorphic independence complex; independent matrix closure confirms 48 elements and fixed vector.
